style: Editorial illustration in the style of a vintage natural-history plate: fine ink linework with muted watercolor wash on warm parchment, restrained palette of ochre, umber, slate blue and muted crimson, soft paper grain, no text, no lettering, no people, no faces. Subject:

prompts.culture/botai-culture: wild horses gathered at a steppe waterhole at dawn, a rope corral of wooden stakes nearby, vast open grassland horizon.
prompts.culture/haudenosaunee-confederacy: a longhouse beneath a great pine tree, five bundled arrows tied together at its base, a forest lake beyond.
prompts.culture/inuit-and-the-thule-expansion: a line of dog-sled tracks crossing pack ice under an aurora-lit sky, a stone inuksuk marker in the foreground.
prompts.era/holocene-epoch: sunrise over a temperate landscape turning from retreating glaciers into forests and small farmed fields, a single young oak in the foreground.
prompts.event/amazonian-urbanism-and-dark-earths: a rainforest clearing with raised circular earthworks and patches of dark fertile soil, causeways radiating between ponds beneath the canopy.
prompts.event/bantu-expansion: a line of clay iron-smelting furnaces and millet fields at the edge of retreating rainforest, a river route continuing toward distant savanna.
prompts.event/bengal-famine-of-1943: an empty clay bowl and a few scattered grains beside a cracked, sun-baked rice paddy, heavy monsoon clouds gathering on the horizon.
prompts.event/carboniferous-coal-forests: towering lycopod and fern forests over a humid swamp where peat is forming, giant dragonflies in the misty air.

prompts.event/collision-of-india-and-asia: a subcontinent drifting northward across an ancient sea toward a great continent, mountain ranges beginning to fold upward where they meet.
prompts.event/colonization-of-land: the first mossy green fringe creeping along a barren rocky shoreline, tide pools reflecting an orange sky, bare continents beyond.
prompts.event/digital-revolution: a single glowing vacuum tube transforming into a chain of ever-smaller circuit chips across a workbench, threads of light connecting them.
prompts.event/divergence-of-the-hominin-lineage: two diverging forest paths, one followed by ape silhouettes into dense canopy, the other by upright silhouettes onto open savanna.

prompts.event/earliest-continental-crust: the first jagged grey landmass rising from a boiling young ocean under a hazy orange sky, steam and lightning above.

prompts.event/fish-to-tetrapod-transition: a lobe-finned fish emerging onto a muddy shore on stubby limb-like fins, ferns and shallow water around it.
prompts.event/formation-of-the-oceans: steam-filled skies raining onto a barren young Earth, the first shallow seas pooling between volcanic islands.
prompts.event/genomic-revolution: a glowing double helix unwinding into a long ribbon of small coloured bands, a magnifying glass and laboratory glassware nearby.
prompts.event/green-revolution: a field of tall traditional grain beside a field of short, dense high-yield wheat, an irrigation channel and stacked sacks between them.
prompts.event/interbreeding-of-homo-sapiens-with: two distinct human silhouettes meeting and their outlines overlapping at a cave entrance, faint firelight behind them.
prompts.event/late-ordovician-extinction: a shallow sea full of trilobites and shelled creatures beneath a darkening icy sky, glaciers advancing at the horizon.
prompts.event/middle-pleistocene-transition: alternating bands of glacial ice sheets and green interglacial valleys stacked like tree rings across a mountainside.
